readme:
# Homegate Rental Listings Scraper (Homegate.ch)

Scrape rental and sale listings from [Homegate.ch](https://www.homegate.ch/), a Swiss property portal. Paste a search URL or set city, canton, price and rooms filters, and get structured listings with CHF prices, GPS coordinates and agent contact.

> **Integration stopped on Nov 11?** After a security incident, Apify rotated the API tokens of affected accounts. If yours was rotated and you call this Actor from n8n, Make, Zapier or your own code, paste your new token (Console → Settings → API & Integrations). Schedules inside Apify were not affected.

## Connection Note

The Actor manages its own connection handling, so there is nothing to configure. If Homegate refuses every request in a run, the run ends with a clear status message and no charges; running again usually helps.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/homegate-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `homegate-scraper` to scrape property listings from homegate. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## What You Get

- **Prices** in CHF (gross, net, extra costs)
- **Location** with address, city, postal code, canton, and GPS coordinates
- **Property details**: rooms, area in m², floor, property type
- **Features**: balcony, parking, elevator, dishwasher, pets allowed, and more
- **Images**: all listing photos with full URLs
- **Description and availability**: description text, `available_from`
- **Agent** (with `includeDetails`): `agent_name`, `agent_company`, `agent_phone`, `agent_logo_url`, `agent_url`, `project_url`
- **Listing metadata**: `listed_at`, `source_url`, `source_platform`, `scraped_at`

## How To Use

### Option 1: Paste a search URL

Copy any Homegate.ch search URL directly from your browser:

```
https://www.homegate.ch/mieten/immobilien/ort-zuerich/trefferliste
https://www.homegate.ch/kaufen/immobilien/ort-bern/trefferliste
https://www.homegate.ch/mieten/immobilien/kanton-zuerich/trefferliste
```

Both URL styles work: the German browser style above (`/mieten/` and `/kaufen/`) and the English style (`/rent/` and `/buy/`, e.g. `https://www.homegate.ch/rent/real-estate/city-zurich/matching-list`). Any URL that is not `/buy/` or `/kaufen/` is treated as a rental search.

### Option 2: Use filters

Set the listing type, city, canton, price range, and minimum rooms in the input fields.

## Input Example

```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.homegate.ch/mieten/immobilien/ort-zuerich/trefferliste"],
  "maxResults": 100,
  "includeDetails": false
}
```

Filter example (rentals in Bern, 3+ rooms, up to CHF 2,500):

```json
{
  "listingType": "rent",
  "city": "Bern",
  "priceMax": 2500,
  "roomsMin": 3,
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

## What You Get Without Detail Pages

The search results already include rich data for every listing, so there is no need to enable `includeDetails` in most cases:

- Title, price (gross), rooms, area, floor
- Full address, city, postal code, canton
- GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude)
- All listing images (15-20 per listing)
- Features (balcony, parking, elevator, etc.)
- Description text
- Listing date and source URL

Enable `includeDetails` to also get agent contact info (name, company, phone) and the price breakdown from the detail page. `price_net` (net rent) and `price_extra` (utilities) are copied from the search data when Homegate includes them, which is often not the case; without `includeDetails` they are frequently `null`. They are always `null` for buy listings.

## Pricing

Pay-per-result pricing. You only pay for the data you receive.

| Event | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Listing scraped | $0.003 | A property listing from search results |
| Detail page extracted | $0.008 | Agent contact info and price breakdown from a listing page |

**Examples:**
- 100 rental listings in Zurich = **$0.30**
- 500 listings across Switzerland = **$1.50**
- 100 listings with full details = **$1.10**

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## FAQ

**Do I need any connection settings or a login?** No. Connection handling is built in and no login is required.

**How many listings can I get?** Up to 10,000 per run (`maxResults`, default 100).

**How fresh is the data?** Each run reads Homegate live, so results reflect what is listed at run time; `listed_at` shows the listing date.

**Can I get agent phone numbers?** Yes, enable `includeDetails`; detail pages are billed separately (see Pricing).

**Does it cover buy listings too?** Yes, set `listingType` to `buy` or use a `/kaufen/` URL.

## Connection

Connection handling is built in and managed by the Actor. There is nothing to configure.

## Data protection

This actor returns only data that is publicly visible on the source pages. Results can include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses and addresses of private persons, sole traders or contact persons. Where the source labels an entry type, it is included so you can filter the results yourself.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including the GDPR/DSGVO, national data-protection laws and unfair-competition rules (e.g. UWG) for marketing and outreach.

## Issues & Feature Requests

If something is not working or you're missing a feature or data field, please [open an issue](https://console.apify.com/actors/be3Av24vUFcXX6dfi/issues) and we'll look into it.
